text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear three-part argument with transitions like \"First,\" \"Then,\" and \"Lastly,\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents ideas in a structured sequence that helps the reader follow its argument."},{"evidence":"repeated reference to the same main claim about families making the decision","quality":"coherence","description":"The essay stays focused on one controlling idea and develops it consistently across paragraphs."},{"evidence":"sentences such as \"Example, some students have a lot of homework, project, tests\" and \"If school wants to control student to get involve\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows better control of sentence boundaries and clause structure, even though errors remain."},{"evidence":"words like \"extracurricular activities,\" \"involved,\" \"program,\" and \"decision\" used in meaningful context","quality":"word choice","description":"The essay uses more accurate academic vocabulary to express its ideas."},{"evidence":"paragraphs that explain reasons and examples in support of the claim","quality":"development","description":"The essay gives more elaboration for its points rather than just repeating general statements."}]}
